body: 依据输入照片和红色圈选标注，只把圈内陶瓷花瓶的釉色改成钴蓝色。保留花瓶的形状、反光、阴影和插花，不改变桌面、墙面及其他物件。最终成图移除红圈和所有标注，维持自然摄影质感。

en.title: Marked vase color edit
en.description: Vase changed from cream to cobalt blue, red markup removed
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt and the displayed original reference assets in order. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Vase changed from cream to cobalt blue, red markup removed. Jug, dried stems, tiles and window remain visually consistent; new glaze is glossier.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#guide-an-edit-with-markup). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，并按展示顺序加入原创参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

## 观察结果

花瓶由米色改为钴蓝，红圈已移除；玻璃壶、干燥枝条、墙砖和窗户保持视觉一致。新釉面比原图更有光泽。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#guide-an-edit-with-markup)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
